Token.Name: Atlas personal token
Token.Hint: Create it in Atlas under Profile → Integrations and paste it here. It stays in this browser only and can only read your account's data.

Language.Name: Atlas language
Language.Hint: Choose the language for Atlas in this browser, or follow the Foundry language.

Source.Name: Atlas world, campaign and characters
Source.Label: Configure integration
Source.Hint: Choose the Atlas source for this Foundry world and link campaign characters.
Source.NoToken: Save your personal token in the Atlas settings first, then reopen this window.
Source.WorldHint: With no campaign selected, access is to the world itself.

Links.Name: Atlas → Foundry characters
Links.Hint: Link each campaign character to a Foundry Actor. Each Actor can represent one character per campaign. Links do not change sheets or permissions.
Links.Empty: No characters available in this campaign.

Importer.Title: Import persons from Atlas
Importer.NoToken: To import, create a token in Atlas (Profile → Integrations) and paste it in the module settings.
Importer.NoSource: Choose a world in the Atlas settings to import persons.

Errors.Network: Could not reach Atlas. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.Unauthorized: The token is no longer valid. Create a new one in Atlas and paste it in the settings.
Errors.Forbidden: Your account cannot see this in Atlas.
Errors.SourceNotFound: The selected source is no longer available. Choose the world and campaign again.
Errors.InvalidLink: A character or Actor is no longer available. Reload the settings.
Errors.DuplicateActor: The same Actor cannot represent two characters in the same campaign.

Sheet.Title: Atlas Person
Sheet.NoLocalPages: No local pages. Use Open journal to access the Foundry journal.
Sheet.NoDocuments: No imported documents. Reimport the person to include the documents available in Atlas.
Sheet.DocumentsSharing: Manage sharing for each document in Open journal.
